description: RFP compliance matrix — Extracts a compliance matrix from an RFP, RFQ, RFI or tender (text= or url= of a web page or PDF): must/should/may requirements with quotes checked against the document, due dates, submission method, evaluation criteria and weights, deliverables, contract terms and risks. An offline shall/must scan lists mandatory sentences the extraction may have missed; includes a CSV matrix. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Request for Proposals RFP-26-01. The City seeks IT support. The Contractor shall provide 24/7 help desk support for all city staff. The Contractor must maintain cyber liability insurance of at least 5,000,000 dollars per occurrence. Proposals are due January 15, 2027. Vendors should include three references.

name: ai_rfp_extract
